name: Sylvia von Tensberg
source: Baroness Sylvia of Tensberg. That's what she would prefer to be called. She despises her father, to whom the title of nobility means nothing and who, to make matters worse, is a mere teacher. Sylvia has to accompany him at the Science Camp, although she has no interest in science whatsoever. Instead, she paints on a very high level, and plans to study art. Her attitude to others can be challenging, but her sharp tongue can also be entertaining.
